No external network, cloud, message-broker, or third-party service may be used.\n"[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'## Requirements\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'Implement the following HTTP API on a long-running Qwik City server. Rooms are created implicitly on first use; a `{room}` path segment is an arbitrary non-empty string of characters `[A-Za-z0-9_-]`.\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'### 1. Publish a message — `POST /api/rooms/{room}/messages`\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'* Request body: JSON `{ "user": string, "text": string }`.\n'[39m +
                [32m'* Validation (all lengths measured after trimming leading/trailing whitespace):\n'[39m +
                [32m'  * `user` must be a string of length 1..64.\n'[39m +
                [32m'  * `text` must be a string of length 1..2000.\n'[39m +
                [32m'  * Any missing/invalid field, wrong type, or malformed JSON body must yield HTTP `400` with body `{ "error": string }` and must NOT be persisted or broadcast.\n'[39m +
                [32m'* On success the server assigns:\n'[39m +
                [32m'  * `seq`: a per-room monotonically increasing integer, starting at `1` and increasing by exactly `1` per accepted message in that room. Sequences must be gapless and unique within a room, assigned atomically even when many messages are posted to the same room concurrently.\n'[39m +
                [32m'  * `ts`: server-side timestamp in integer epoch milliseconds.\n'[39m +
                [32m'* Any `seq` or `ts` present in the client request body MUST be ignored and overwritten by the server.\n'[39m +
                [32m'* The message must be persisted durably to the local SQLite history and then delivered to the live subscribers of this room only.\n'[39m +
                [32m'* Response: HTTP `201` with JSON body containing exactly the keys `room` (string), `seq` (integer), `user` (string), `text` (string), `ts` (integer).\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'### 2. Subscribe to a room — `GET /api/rooms/{room}/stream`\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'* Responds as an SSE stream with response header `Content-Type: text/event-stream`.\n'[39m +
                [32m'* Replay-then-live semantics on connect:\n'[39m +
                [32m'  * If the request carries a `Last-Event-ID` header parseable as integer `L`, the server must first emit every stored message of this room with `seq > L`, in ascending `seq` order, then continue streaming newly published messages live.\n'[39m +
                [32m'  * Otherwise, the server must first emit the most recent up to 50 stored messages of this room, in ascending `seq` order (all of them if fewer than 50 exist), then continue streaming newly published messages live.\n'[39m +
                [32m'* Room isolation: a subscription to `{room}` must receive ONLY messages published to that exact room, and never messages of any other room.\n'[39m +
                [32m'* Delivery must be in ascending `seq` order with no gaps and no duplicates, so that a client reconnecting with `Last-Event-ID` resumes exactly where it left off.\n'[39m +
                [32m'* Event framing: every delivered message is exactly one SSE event whose three fields appear on their own lines in this order, followed by one blank line terminating the event:\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'  ```\n'[39m +
                [32m'  id: {seq}\n'[39m +
                [32m'  event: message\n'[39m +
                [32m'  data: {json}\n'[39m +
                [32m'  ```\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'  where `{seq}` is the message sequence and `{json}` is a single-line (no embedded newlines) compact JSON object containing exactly the keys `room`, `seq`, `user`, `text`, `ts` with the same values that were persisted.\n'[39m +
                [32m'* When a subscriber disconnects, its subscription must be torn down and all associated resources released (no leaked subscribers, no leaked timers/streams).\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'### 3. Room presence — `GET /api/rooms/{room}/presence`\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'* Responds HTTP `200` with JSON `{ "room": string, "subscribers": integer }`, where `subscribers` is the current number of active SSE subscriptions to that room. The count must increase when a client connects and decrease when a client disconnects.\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'### 4. Durability\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'* Message history and the per-room sequence counter must survive a full server restart. After a restart, a new subscription must replay the previously stored messages, and newly published messages must continue the sequence after the highest stored `seq` for that room (no reset to 1, no gap).\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +

                  [32m'import { db, broker, type Message } from "../../../../../lib/db";\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'export const onGet: RequestHandler = async (event) => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const { params, headers, status, getWritableStream, request, signal, json } = event;\n'[39m +

                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  // 4. Parse Last-Event-ID header\n'[39m +

                  [32m'  let L: number | null = null;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  if (lastEventIdHeader !== null) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const parsed = parseInt(lastEventIdHeader, 10);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    if (!isNaN(parsed)) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      L = parsed;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  // 5. Setup subscription and queue\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const queue: Message[] = [];\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  let replaying = true;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  let maxSeq = L !== null ? L : 0;\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  const unsubscribe = broker.subscribe(room, (msg: Message) => {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    if (replaying) {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      queue.push(msg);\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    } else {\n'[39m +

                  [32m'      }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +

                  [32m'  signal.addEventListener("abort", cleanup);\n'[39m +

            [32m'When using the newTask tool, the agentType parameter is optional. Leave it empty (None) to launch a generic sub agent, or specify one of the available agent types below to select a specialized agent.\n'[39m +
            [32m'Available agent types and the tools they have access to:\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'### browser\n'[39m +

            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'### explore\n'[39m +
            [32m'Use this agent to explore the codebase when you need to: understand project structure, find where features are implemented, locate specific functions or classes, analyze code patterns, investigate how something works, search for examples or usage, or gather information before making changes.\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Examples of questions this agent shall trigger:\n'[39m +

            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'### guide\n'[39m +
            [32m"A comprehensive guide for learning about Pochi's capabilities, features, and configuration.\n"[39m +
            [32m'This agent helps users understand how to use Pochi effectively, fetch documentation, and modify their config file (.pochi/config.jsonc) with proper confirmation.\n'[39m +

            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Trigger examples:\n'[39m +

            [32m'- Configuration: "how do I configure Pochi?", "explain config options", "help me modify my config", "set up a new provider", "add an MCP server"\n'[39m +
            [32m'- Help & feedback: "join the discord", "report a bug", "where can I get help?"\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'### planner\n'[39m +
            [32m'Engage this agent to formulate comprehensive, technical implementation strategies for feature development, system refactoring, or defect resolution.\n'[39m +
            [32m'This agent is strictly limited to planning and architectural design; it DOES NOT execute code modifications.\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Examples of user requests this agent shall trigger:\n'[39m +
            [32m'- "create a plan to implement the user authentication feature"\n'[39m +
